system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: little-coder injects a short usage card for the tools a turn is likely to need, chosen by error-recovery > recency > intent.
system_prompt_style.note: Per-turn skill/knowledge blocks; since v1.12.0 injected as trailing message by default, system placement via LITTLE_CODER_INJECT_MODE=system. AGENTS.md discovered by pi.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent uses the directory you launched it from as its working directory — `Read` / `Write` / `Edit` / `Bash` operate on your project
env_context_strategy.note: Glob/grep/find tools provided; no up-front tree injection shown.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: read-guard/ # trims a Read that would overflow the context window to its first 30 lines + a search-instead directive
context_compaction.note: pi auto-compaction summarizes (reserveTokens/keepRecentTokens), triggered mid-run at 80% by context-watchdog.

observation_format.evidence_quote: What the model receives is a bounded excerpt plus the exit code — never the whole log
observation_format.note: Browser tools (Playwright) return extracted text; screenshot observations not evidenced.

tool_call_format.note: Native tool_calls default; parser fallback for text formats.

tool_count.note: Tool definition files in extensions not opened; README lists read/write/edit/bash, glob/webfetch/websearch, grep/find, dispatch, Shell*, Browser*, Evidence* but exact default schema list not available.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: use `Write` for a new file, `Edit` for an existing one
edit_primitive.note: Write refuses on existing files (new files only).

tool_schema_source.note: Tool schema source code not in evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: No dependency file contents in bundle; README says no built-in ACP server (community bridge only); MCP mentioned only for historical v0.0.x.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Every little-coder mechanism ships as a pi extension that hooks pi's lifecycle events
loop_primitives.note: Plan Mode (plan_execute) and Deep Research pipeline are opt-in.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Approving it saves the plan to `.pi/approved-plan.md` and stops there
planning_granularity.note: Default no plan object; opt-in Plan Mode writes a plan file re-read by /implement (explicit_plan_object).

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: little-coder can spawn isolated child sessions to research a question (read the repo + browse online, read-only) and report back concisely
multi_agent_topology.note: dispatch tool shipped in default extension set.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: subagent/ # `dispatch` tool: isolated read/browse-only sub-coders + live tracker (spawn.ts engine)

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: `manual`: prompt for confirmation before every shell command — the command is shown and you choose to execute (`y`) or cancel (`n`).
human_in_loop.note: Default `auto` whitelist; plan approval in opt-in Plan Mode.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: evidence/ # EvidenceAdd/Get/List — per-session store, 1 KB snippet cap
short_term_state.note: Evidence store is a per-session scratch store; closest could be scratchpad; state object code not seen.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: skills/ # 30 markdown files the extensions inject on demand
long_term_memory.note: Static shipped skills; prompt history persists across sessions but is not model memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Use `/resume` to list and reopen past sessions for the current directory.

self_verification.evidence_quote: quality-monitor/ # empty / hallucinated / loop detection + correction follow-up
self_verification.note: Deep-research judge.ts exists (llm_judge in opt-in pipeline) but not verified.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: thinking-budget/ # cap thinking tokens per turn, retry with thinking off

termination_condition.evidence_quote: turn-cap/ # max_turns abort (Polyglot unbounded, TB 40, GAIA 30)
termination_condition.note: Loop detection in quality-monitor; whether it stops the run unverified.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: thinking-budget/ # cap thinking tokens per turn, retry with thinking off
cost_controls.note: Prefix caching preserved by injection placement; per-phase models (plan/action) is routing by phase.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Jobs run in their own process group and are signalled as a group
execution_isolation.note: Runs on host; benchmark adapters use containers.

network_policy.evidence_quote: extra-tools/ # glob, webfetch, websearch (pi ships grep/find)

permission_model.evidence_quote: `auto`: block any shell command not on the whitelist.

tracing.evidence_quote: benchmarks/rpc_client.py # PiRpc — spawns `pi --mode rpc`, demuxes events + UI requests
tracing.note: Session trees persisted by pi; trace format not seen.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: aider_polyglot.py # Polyglot driver with per-language transforms

guardrails.evidence_quote: `ls && rm -rf /` is refused on the `rm`, not allowed on the `ls`.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: pi provides the agent loop, provider abstraction, TUI, and extension model.

primary_artifact.note: Paper corresponds to v0.0.2 Python version.
